about: The data jobs, read by the daily Data health check (dev/data_health.py) and by the site's live data status (shared/datastatus.js: the footer and the data-collection page). Rules in docs/DATA-UPDATES.md. cron: the workflow's schedule in UTC, exactly as in its .yml file (the health check compares them); max_age_hours: the longest time allowed since the job's last successful run; grace_hours: how long a source may stay failed before it is reported (0: at once); sources: the names used in the job's status file, with a label and the agency for the site; a source updated on a longer cycle also has every_days (how often it runs), retry_days (how soon a failed run is tried again) and max_age_days (the longest time allowed since its last success, checked by the health check). known_notes: notes from a job's log that are already known and listed in docs/ROADMAP.md, left out of the report. reviews: tasks done by hand on a cycle; after doing one, set its last_done to that date.

asteroid-data.name: Asteroid data
asteroid-data.about: Close approaches, the orbit of every near-Earth asteroid, impact-risk lists, this week's asteroids and their positions in the sky.

spacecraft-data.name: Spacecraft data
spacecraft-data.about: Where every active spacecraft in the catalogue is, from low Earth orbit to the Voyagers, and a check of every mission link.

astronaut-photos.name: Astronaut photos
astronaut-photos.about: The newest photos of Earth taken by astronauts on the International Space Station, placed on the globe.

mars-data.name: Mars data
mars-data.about: New weather measurements from Curiosity and Perseverance as NASA releases them, cleaned, checked and charted.

build-places.name: Place and map lists
build-places.about: Natural features, volcanoes, coastlines, borders and place names for the Earth map and the globe, and the official place names on the Moon and Mars maps.

planet-names.label: Moon and Mars place names
planet-names.agency: IAU, via NASA Trek and USGS

rover-routes.name: Rover routes
rover-routes.about: Where Curiosity and Perseverance are on Mars, and the routes they have driven, for the Mars map.

clock.about: The outside clock (decided Nov 17, 2026): free timers at cron-job.org start each job at its cron times through GitHub's API (workflow_dispatch), with a fine-grained token limited to this repository's Actions; GitHub's own schedule stays as the backup. set_up: the date the timers were made (empty until then); token_expires: the token's expiry date.
